title: Which U.S. state will report the country's first measles death of 2026?
background: Measles can cause fatal complications, and state health departments monitor and report deaths associated with the disease.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : Official state health department announcements, corroborated by contemporaneous reporting from reliable news organizations. 
  Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the state that publicly reports a measles death among its residents occurring in calendar year 2026 and identified as the first reported U.S. measles fatality of that year. Resolution occurs when that announcement is made. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The name of the U.S. state.
